title: Natsume Ono to Launch Korore Spinoff Manga of ACCA-13, Badon Manga
content:
The official X/Twitter account of Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine revealed on Monday that Natsume Ono will launch a new manga spinoff of her ACCA-13 Territory Inspection Department ( ACCA 13-Ku Kansatsu-Ka ) and BADON manga titled KORORE (preview image seen bottom left in post below) in the magazine's third 2027 issue on February 25, 2027. As with BADON , the title KORORE is one of the 13 territories in the Dowa Kingdom, the shared setting that began with ACCA 13-Territory Inspection Department .

ACCA 13-Territory Inspection Department ran in Monthly Big Gangan from June 2013 to October 2016, and Square Enix released six compiled book volumes for the manga. Yen Press released the manga in English. The manga inspired a 2017 television anime , which Crunchyroll streamed. The anime had an OVA episode sequel titled ACCA: 13-Territory Inspection Dept. Regards in February 2020, which Crunchyroll also streamed.

Ono launched the BADON manga in Monthly Big Gangan in January 2019, and ended it in March 2024. Square Enix released the manga's ninth volume in April 2024.

Since Ono made her debut in 2003 with La Quinta Camera - 5 Banme no Heya , her works have included House of Five Leaves , Ristorante Paradiso , Gente - Ristorante no Hitobito , Tesoro , and Not Simple . Viz Media has published all of these titles in North America. Kodansha USA published Ono's Danza manga in English.

Ono's other manga series include Lady and Oldman in Shueisha 's Ultra Jump magazine, and Have a Great Sunday in Kodansha 's Morning two magazine.

Aside from ACCA 13-Territory Inspection Department , House of Five Leaves , Ristorante Paradiso , and have all inspired television anime adaptations. She also provided the character designs for Shingo Natsume and Madhouse 's upcoming ghost – end of night ( ghost/yoru no hate ) theatrical anime , which opens on February 11. Shingo Natsume also directed the adaptation of Ono's ACCA 13-Territory Inspection Department

title: Attack on Titan Director Breaks Silence on Eren’s Voice After 13 Years
content:
The voice behind Eren Yeager has been iconic ever since the anime debut, and the director finally reveals why. Even several years after the main story’s ending, the popularity of Attack on Titan only keeps increasing. The anime returns with theatrical re-releases, merchandise, and all kinds of exciting updates for fans. This is all the more reason why the series has maintained its fan base over the years. This is especially the case since the anime has two major studios backing it up. While the first three seasons were produced by WIT Studio, the final season was adapted by MAPPA.

Due to the controversial ending and the sudden change of studio, MAPPA had to deal with a lot of pressure for the final season, but the anime became a massive success, and fans love all episodes from both series. A film compilation from WIT Studio, Attack on Titan: Crimson Bow and Arrow , returned to the Japanese theatres. This compilation movie initially premiered in 2014 as a recap of the first anime season. This is the first time the movie has been released in new versions. However, so far, it has only been hit the Japanese theatres on October 23rd, 2026, with much better animation and sound quality than what’s available on streaming platforms.

Attack on Titan Director Reveals How He Chose Eren’s Voice Actor

During the stage greeting, director Tetsuro Araki shared, “I thought Kaji would be a good fit for Eren because he’s a good person with a touch of madness.” The stage greeting, shared by Oricon , took place on October 23rd since this is the first time the compilation movie was released in Screen X theatres. Yuki Kaji is one of the most renowned voice actors in the industry, and most of his popularity is thanks to his iconic role as Eren Yeager. While the animation studio changed for the final season, MAPPA kept the same voice actors since they were already known for their roles in the series.

Meanwhile, Araki, who served as the Chief Animation Director of the first three seasons, also chose Yuki Kaji as Eren’s voice. More than 13 years after the anime’s debut, he reveals that the reason he chose Kaji was that he’s a good person with a touch of madness. That kind of quality is very much in tune with the beloved character, which Araki recognized right away and knew instinctively that he would be a good fit for the protagonist. Meanwhile, Kaji also shared his experience before being chosen for the role. While he was happy with the audition, he was surprised to know that the role he was offered was for Eren and not Armin. Regardless, there’s no denying that things turned out for the best, and this remains his most popular role so far.

Will Attack on Titan Return With New Anime?

At this point, it’s pretty much useless to hope for a new anime since the entire manga has already been adapted. Hajime Isayama never returned with a sequel, spin-off, or even an extra chapter for the anime to continue after adapting the main story. However, that doesn’t mean it’s the end of the franchise since September 9th was declared Attack on Titan Day starting this year. This means that from now on, every year on the same day, both animation studios will celebrate this exceptional series with new updates, merchandise, and even releases for fans. Additionally, MAPPA will adapt the final storyline for the upcoming game, Attack on Titan 3 . The game is scheduled to be released on December 10th, 2026, which gives fans something new to look forward to by the end of the year.

title: Sachiko Uguisu's Kaikai Gigigigigi Manga Ends
content:
Futabasha 's Comic Action platform published the final chapter of Sachiko Uguisu 's Kaikai Gigigigigi manga on Tuesday.

The series follows a trio of high school students who dive into the mysteries of Kaminari City's strange K-Zone, where strange phenomena are said to occur.

Uguisu launched the series on Futabasha 's Comic Action platform in April 2025. Futabasha shipped the second compiled book volume on May 14.

Star Fruit Books publishes Uguisu's Children, Don't Play In The Dark manga in English. Trash Up shipped the single volume in July 2016.

title: Bleach Creator Finally Addresses His Influence on Demon Slayer and Jujutsu Kaisen
content:
More than 22 years after its anime debut, Bleach has finally reached its conclusion with the Thousand-Year Blood War Arc. The anime released its final part as part of the Summer 2026 lineup and reached its conclusion after a major delay. As part of the Shonen Big Three alongside One Piece and Naruto, Bleach has always been celebrated as one of the most iconic Shonen Jump anime and manga franchises of all time. However, despite the franchise’s popularity and the manga ending, it took Pierrot around a decade to return with a sequel to adapt the Thousand-Year Blood War Arc of the manga.

The final arc of the main story was split into four parts, and it returned with far better quality animation, pacing, and original scenes, without unnecessary filler episodes. While it’s shorter than the previous cours, the finale solved the major issues with the original ending , which is all the more reason why fans love the anime ending more than the manga. However, now that the story has finally wrapped up, creator Tite Kubo opens up about influencing popular series such as Demon Slayer and Jujutsu Kaisen , the two hottest Shonen Jump series among the new-generation hits.

Bleach Creator Shares Thoughts on Influencing Demon Slayer and Jujutsu Kaisen

Following the anime finale, HYPEBEAST shared a magazine interview with the creator for their Issue 38. When asked about Bleach influencing the new generation of manga, Kubo replies, “People often say that the captains of the Gotei 13 influenced the Hashira in Demon Slayer , or that concepts like Bankai inspired aspects of Jujutsu Kaisen .”

He continues, “The creators of those series have told me that they were influenced by BLEACH , so I think it’s fair to say that influence exists. But I don’t think influence is something that flows in only one direction. It’s something that’s passed from one generation of creators to the next.”

As an iconic Shonen Jump series that follows many popular tropes, it’s no surprise that Bleach has been used as an inspiration for the new generation of manga. Demon Slayer and Jujutsu Kaisen are the two most popular Shonen series in recent years, and it’s not a coincidence that they are both inspired by the same series. However, while talking about the two series, Kubo addresses that influences evolve over time. Just like how he was inspired by Saint Seiya as a child and used the Gotei 13 as his interpretation of the Gold Saints, Demon Slayer and Jujutsu Kaisen creators also made their versions of Gotei 13. Kubo also mentions how this helps creativity evolve over time, through generations, resulting in newer versions of stories.

Bleach ‘s Anime Finale May Not Be the End of the Franchise Yet

Even though the manga already ended a decade ago and the anime wrapped up as well, fans still have something new to look forward to . Bleach also needs to adapt the one-shot Kubo released in 2021 as part of the manga’s 20th anniversary. Titled No Breathes From Hell , the one-shot manga opened room for the story’s expansion, as it shed more light on Ichigo’s future and those around him. However, even if the manga didn’t expand the story completely with a longer run, there’s still a high possibility that the one-shot will be adapted into an anime, which will be just as exciting. Fans have been awaiting the Hell Arc for several years now. While several unofficial reports claim that the manga will return to Weekly Shonen Jump with a brand new story, there hasn’t been an official confirmation yet, so there’s no way to verify those rumors.

title: The Full-Time Wife Escapist's Tsunami Umino Launches New Manga in December
content:
The December issue of Hakusensha 's Melody magazine announced on Wednesday that it will launch a serialization of Tsunami Umino 's previous one-shot manga Omiai Tantei Katabiranotsuji Nagi (Matchmaking Detective Nagi Katabiranotsuji) in the magazine's February 2027 issue on December 25. The series' launch will include the original one-shot (image below) that first debutedon Hakusensha 's Hana Yume Ai digital manga magazine in 2018.

The manga tells the story of Nagi, the daughter of the prestigious Katabiranotsuji family. At a meeting for an arranged marriage, Nagi suddenly blurts to her prospect husband that she wants to visit his house. What is her true intention with the sudden and bizarre request?

Umino began the The Full-Time Wife Escapist ( Nigeru wa Haji da ga Yaku ni Tatsu ) manga in November 2012, and ended the manga in February 2020. Kodansha shipped the 11th and final compiled book volume in April 2020. The manga won the shojo category of the 39th Kodansha Awards. Kodansha USA Publishing publishes the manga digitally in English.

A live-action television series adaptation aired in Japan in fall 2016. A live-action special aired in December 2020.

Umino's Kuroema Chloe et Emma manga inspired a five-episode live-action mini-series adaptation, which debuted worldwide exclusively on Amazon Prime Video on June 12. Umino launched the manga in Kodansha 's Kiss magazine in August 2022. Kodansha published the manga's fifth volume on August 12.

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Kaiju No. 8
content:
Kaiju No. 8 ‘s anime debut in 2024 made it one of the most distinctive anime of the year, and the real reason lies in its narrative and unconventional protagonist. As a man in his 30s, Kafka Hibino immediately breaks the mold of the shonen genre, and as he gains his powers and embarks on his journey, something truly inspiring unfolds.

It has a simple narrative for a heavy action series while featuring several other great elements. It’s no wonder fans might miss the anime. So, until it returns next year with a new season, here are a few anime with nuances that make them very similar to Kaiju No. 8 .

3) Attack On Titan

Attack on Titan is similar to Kaiju No. 8 in its action, featuring massive monsters against puny humans who constantly face danger and death. However, Attack on Titan does it much better, with large-scale battles and a wider cast of characters whose connections are deeply woven into the narrative. It also features a protagonist who gains the powers of the very monsters he hates.

While this is a classic trope in heavy-action shonen and seinen anime, Attack on Titan undoubtedly executes it better than most, thanks to the gravity of this concept and its impact on the protagonist. As funny as Kaiju No. 8 can be with its protagonist, Attack on Titan takes a much more serious approach. With around 94 episodes, Attack on Titan is more than enough to fill the void left by Kaiju No. 8 .

2) Chainsaw Man

The standout element of Kaiju No. 8 is its protagonist , who is far from your typical shonen anime hero. If that is what made Kaiju No. 8 stand out for some fans, then they should watch Chainsaw Man , which arguably has one of the most distinctive shonen protagonists ever. While many shonen anime protagonists strive to save the world or pursue great ambitions, Chainsaw Man ‘s Denji only hopes to survive the day, eat a proper meal, and, ultimately, get a girlfriend.

Denji’s journey takes a similar turn when he gains the powers of a devil and is recruited to work for the Devil Hunters, an organization that essentially serves as the series’ Defense Force. Chainsaw Man is the best anime to watch if you loved the comedic and action elements of Kaiju No. 8 , as it elevates both and arguably executes them even better.

1) Dandadan

Dandadan arrived in the fall 2024 season after Kaiju No. 8 and emerged as a hilarious replacement for what the latter left behind with its 12-episode run. The main element these two anime share is their bizarre atmosphere, but Dandadan takes this bizarreness to a whole new level. It does so with the ridiculous premise of its main characters embarking on a journey to find the male lead’s lost privates, encountering ghosts and aliens along the way.

However, when the anime gets serious and aims to inspire its audience, it delivers just as much as any shonen anime. The action might be Dandadan ‘s greatest strength, and much of that comes from SCIENCE SARU’s anime adaptation . The action is elevated through the studio’s brilliant use of color palettes, making the anime incredibly vibrant and allowing it to stand out among other action series. Honestly, Dandadan isn’t just a replacement for Kaiju No. 8 ; its variety is so vast that it can help fill the void left by anime across multiple genres, including action, romance, and supernatural, making it the perfect replacement for almost any anime you might be missing.

title: Yuki Amemiya, Yukino Ichihara's My Husband is a Doomsday Weapon Manga Ends
content:
The December issue of Ichijinsha 's Monthly Comic Zero-Sum magazine published the final chapter of Yuki Amemiya and Yukino Ichihara 's My Husband is a Doomsday Weapon ( Danna-sama wa Shūmatsu Heiki ) manga on Wednesday.

Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga, and will release the first volume in English on December 22. The company describes the story:

The first ever post-apocalyptic hard sci-fi human/android romance?! Four hundred years have passed since the Doomsday War, when the autonomous killing machines known as weapon-auts turned on their human makers and reduced the world to ruins. Today, the remnants of humanity pick through the scattered fragments of the past, scavenging and restoring relics of old-world tech as they claw their way back from the brink. Enter Yoshua, a quiet, sheltered researcher at the National Defense Center for Aut Research in the Kingdom of Fors. After an accident during a routine excavation leaves her unconscious, she wakes up to a terrifying sight: a battleship-grade weapon-aut staring back at her…! A walking weapon of mass destruction meets an unlucky-in-love scientist in this high-stakes, sci-fi twist on a master-servant love story!

Amemiya and Ichihara launched the manga in Monthly Comic Zero-Sum in November 2024. Ichijinsha published the manga's second comppiled book volume on January 30. Amemiya writes the story, and Ichihara draws the art.

Amemiya and Ichihara launched their Long Goodbye My Honey manga in Monthly Comic Zero-Sum in January 2021, and ended it in January 2023. Ichijinsha released the manga's third and final volume in February 2023.

Amemiya and Ichihara launched the 07-Ghost manga in 2005 and ended it in 2013. Go! Comi published the beginning of the manga in North America in 2008, and Viz Media picked up the license in 2012.

The manga inspired a television anime series in 2009. Ichijinsha also published the one-volume side-story manga 07-Ghost Children in 2010.

The authors then launched the Battle Rabbits ( Bato Rabbits ) manga in Monthly Comic Zero-Sum in September 2014, and ended it in 2016 with four volumes. Seven Seas Entertainment published the manga in English.

The manga inspired a television anime series in 2009. Ichijinsha also published the one-volume side-story manga 07-Ghost Children in 2010.

The authors then launched the Battle Rabbits ( Bato Rabbits ) manga in Monthly Comic Zero-Sum in September 2014, and ended it in 2016 with four volumes. Seven Seas Entertainment published the manga in English.

title: Dragon Ball’s Frieza Armor Is Still Iconic After 28 Years & Here’s Why
content:
Dragon Ball Z made its premiere with Toonami in 1998 , and the world was introduced to a vast array of new characters, power levels and looks to the franchise. One of newest wardrobes was the Frieza battle armor, which was worn by invading Saiyans. The massive shoulder pads, thigh guards and hard exterior shell looked like a simple addition. Nevertheless, it’s continued to stay in the franchise with various changes and updates.

First off, Vegeta made this particular look famous. Yes, Raditz, Nappa and more wore the same look, but the egotistical , ultra-powerful Prince of Saiyans just made the entire ensemble work better. His personality and dismissive attitude just made the armor look cooler. From there, it continued to get better and better before it was adopted by the Z Fighters eventually. And through all of its reinvention, it’s made the armor more iconic than ever.

First Update Made The Uniform Better

The full armor did look cool, but Vegeta’s pad removal/vest look took them a step further. It’s a perfect example of less is more. As the Earth Saiyans continued to gain more power and ascend to higher Super Saiyan levels, they needed more mobility. This look played right into that. It also changed up the meaning as it relates to Vegeta’s former employer. The original looked felt more tied to Frieza . This change quietly told the audience that the fighters wearing the modified look were not a part of his evil force.

In terms of creative choices, it was a brilliant move for Akira Toriyama. It allowed him to show the fighters’ progress better without the armor getting in the way . The Cell Saga is the best example of this improved look. Future Trunks and Vegeta ascended to grades 2 and 3 of Super Saiyan when they battled the android. Although they didn’t go to Super Saiyan 3, it showed the audience that there were sub-levels to the first ascension and it was very obvious that they had bulked up in the hyperbolic chamber.

The armor helped the other father-son duo train in the chamber. Goku and Gohan change from their iconic gi and Namekian clothes respectively to train with the armor. It added another new perspective to the look. Vegeta was still growing as a character at this point and still represented someone that wasn’t fully good. When Goku and Gohan put on the armor, it represented a change that having it on didn’t make the character evil. It was just another way to improve as a fighter. Of course, it was in that journey that Gohan became the strongest character in the show for a short time , so the armor training clearly worked.

Frieza Force Made Its Own Changes

Frieza and his army continued to work on their advanced technology throughout the franchise and that included the armor and obviously outdated scanners. Dragon Ball Super: Broly gave everyone a completely new look. Although Frieza stopped wearing the armor because his constantly changing power forms, everyone else on the ship got to change into some new digs.

Cheelai and Lemo were the first two to show the changes, and it featured a lot more versatility. Some chose to wear the vest-only, Vegeta look. While others continued in the old-school fashion of full armor. One thing the armor did do was show off how absurdly strong Broly was. When he gets a new set on Frieza’s ship, the shoulder pads and everything else look so small in comparison to the giant . It set the tone for how strong of character he was without even having to see him fight.

The armor also managed to stay intact for the bulk of the fight. Whereas, the armor failed or broke in many smaller scale battles over the course of the series. Broly only had his armor fail when Gogeta appeared in Super Saiyan Blue form. Even then, it lasted for a bit before the reality-breaking attack. What started out as a uniform worn by evil world conquerors has now turned into an iconic Saiyan look.

It’s a rare transition for most shows or movies. A character’s uniform is a telltale sign where they stand – with the good guys or the bad guys. Dragon Ball did a good job of including this look on both sides to keep it going for the long term. What do you think? Was it the right move to keep the Frieza look going for this long? Let us know in the comments.

title: Digimon Alysion Smartphone Card Game Opens Pre-Registration with New Trailer
content:
Bandai Card Games' Digimon Alysion mobile card game announced on Thursday in a new trailer that pre-registration is open in 49 countries and regions. The game is planned for a 2026 release.

The free-to-play game will feature online card battles. The game was initially announced during Digimon Con in March 2025.

The game features an original story that takes place in the same world as the Digimon Liberator vertical-scrolling webcomic , which launched in April 2024.

The Digimon Story Time Stranger game launched for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in October 2025. The game launched for Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 on July 10. The Switch 2 version features improved graphics as well as performance mode and quality mode.

Bandai Namco Entertainment announced in March a new mobile game titled Digimon UP . The game launched on July 15. Bandai Namco describes that the game's concept built around "a Digimon journey that moves with your life."

title: Reiko Shimizu's Himitsu Season 0 Spinoff Manga Enters Final Arc
content:
The December issue of Hakusensha 's Melody magazine announced on Wednesday that Reiko Shimizu 's Himitsu Season 0 ( Himitsu - The Top Secret season 0 ) spinoff manga will start its final arc in the magazine's February 2027 issue on December 25.

The spinoff of the original Himitsu - Top Secret manga debuted in Melody in October 2012. Hakusensha shipped the manga's 12th compiled book volume on July 3. The manga went on hiatus in August 2021 so that the creator could prepare for a new arc, and it returned after two years in October 2023. The manga begins by telling the story of the agent Maki prior to the events of the original series.

Himitsu - Top Secret inspired the Top Secret ~The Revelation~ television anime by Madhouse in 2008. It also inspired a live-action film in August 2016.

The original manga recently inspired a live-action series that debuted in January 2025.
